senses.definition_en: lawyer, solicitor, counsel.

examples.english: “You don't say another word. We'll call my lawyer, and that's it.”
examples.ref: 1984, Víctor Chamorro, El muerto resucitado, page 159:
examples.text: «—Usted no vuelva a responder ni una sola palabra. Llamaremos a mi abogado y se acabó».
examples.translation: “You don't say another word. We'll call my lawyer, and that's it.”

examples.english: “I had to look him straight in the eye and tell him, face to face, that the years at university, the family lawyer, were heading toward the same fate as that shaving. It took courage.”
examples.ref: 1982, Vlady Kociancich, La octava maravilla, page 39:
examples.text: «Debía mirarlo cara a cara y decirle, cara a cara, que los años de Facultad, el abogado de la familia, corrían hacia el mismo destino que esa viruta. Se necesitaba coraje».
examples.translation: “I had to look him straight in the eye and tell him, face to face, that the years at university, the family lawyer, were heading toward the same fate as that shaving. It took courage.”

glosses: lawyer, solicitor, counsel.
